newsitem.title: TURKEY: Major Turkish biscuit producer to float shares.
newsitem.headline: Major Turkish biscuit producer to float shares.

text.p: Biscuit and chocolate cookie producer Anadolu Gida Sanayi A.S. of Turkey's leading biscuit group Ulker will offer five percent of its capital to the public on October 14-15, T.Is Bankasi, co-leader of the consortium said.
The offer price is fixed at 27,500 lira per 1,000 lira nominal-valued share, the bank said.
Private T. Ekonomi Bankasi is also a co-leader in the two-member consortium which will manage the offer.
Anadolu Gida has a 228.4 billion lira capital, with 43.7 percent of it held by Yildiz Gida, one of the 22 firms within the Ulker group.

Anadolu Gida, the group's second largest company, reported net sales of 5.8 trillion lira and net profits of 318.5 billion lira in 1995. Its net sales for the first six months of 1996 were 3.5 trillion lira and net profits were 443.5 billion lira. -- Istanbul Newsroom +90-212-2750875
